title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 5B: Hotels
subtitle: Hotel words and there isn’t / Is there …? from 5B

words.def: a part of a building with walls and a door
words.sent: My hotel ___ has a big bed.

words.def: a thing you sleep on
words.sent: There’s a big ___ in the room.

words.def: a long container you fill with water and sit in to wash
words.sent: There isn’t a ___, only a shower.

words.def: water comes down on you and you wash
words.sent: There isn’t a bath, but there’s a ___.

words.def: a machine with a screen for programmes
words.sent: There aren’t any ___ in the rooms.

words.def: the internet with no cable
words.sent: Is there ___ in the room? I need the internet.

words.def: a soft thing for your head in bed
words.sent: Can I have another ___?

words.def: a warm cover for your bed
words.sent: There aren’t any ___ and it’s cold!

words.def: a cloth to dry your body
words.sent: I need a ___ after my shower.

words.def: a place where you leave your car
words.sent: Is there a ___ here? — Yes, behind the hotel.

words.def: a cheap place to stay, often with beds in one big room
words.sent: A ___ is cheap. Rooms usually only have beds.

words.def: a place to stay with private rooms, a TV and a bathroom
words.sent: A ___ room usually has a TV and a shower.

words.def: a big hole in a mountain or under the ground
words.sent: The Cave Hostel is in a ___ in Cappadocia.

words.def: a person at the hotel desk who helps guests
words.sent: The ___ gives George the key to his room.

words.def: a person who stays at a hotel
words.sent: The hotel has 20 rooms for ___.

words.def: what a person writes about a hotel or a film
words.sent: I read a ___ of the hostel online. It says it’s great.

words.vi: nào (dùng trong câu phủ định / câu hỏi số nhiều)
words.def: used in questions and negatives with plural nouns
words.sent: Are there ___ cafés near here?

words.def: not far from this place
words.sent: Is there a supermarket ___? — Yes, in the next street.

words.def: a question about one thing in a place
words.sent: ___ a car park here? — Yes, there is.

words.def: not one; there is not
words.sent: ___ a restaurant in the hostel.
